PWM Basics & Diagnostics Cheat Sheet

A quick-reference for equations, common component frequencies, and diagnostic measurements on modern automotive PWM circuits.

Core Equations

D = T_on / T
Duty Cycle (%)
f = 1 / T
Frequency (Hz)
V_avg = V_src × D
Average Voltage (V)

Common Automotive PWM Frequencies

Component Typical Frequency Strategy
Cabin Blower Fan100 Hz – 500 HzLow-Side PWM
Electronic Fuel Pump100 Hz – 20 kHzFuel pump driver module (FPDM)
EVAP Purge Solenoid10 Hz – 30 HzSlow switching
Fuel InjectorsDynamic (with engine RPM)Pulse width dictates fuel volume
DMM sanity check

A multimeter in DC voltage mode reads average voltage. If a 12 V fan circuit reads 6 V, the duty cycle is likely around 50% — that is correct behavior, not a fault. Use an oscilloscope to see the actual waveform.
